text:
Olivia Chen: quick async — starting Helios-9b onboarding for the catalog. I put a draft manifest here: https://go/repo/helios-manifest and a checklist in the doc. Need owners for licensing, perf, and canary plan.

Kevin Patel: assigned infra owner for perf profiling. I can run latency/throughput baseline next week. need model files + sample workload.

Sarah Lee: I can own curation & eval sets. Will pull together 50 sample prompts (QA, summarization, code). ETA Tue.

James O'Neill: legal ping — @Maria can you confirm license compatibility? model repo README says "Custom Research Use" with some restrictions.

Maria Gomez: saw that. Looks like a non-commercial clause. Need to confirm exact wording in model license file. If NC present we can't host publicly in catalog without legal sign-off. I'll review tonight and comment.

Olivia Chen: thanks. If NC exists we might still include in private/dedicated but mark as restricted. Please flag exact text.

Kevin Patel: infra question — what precision do we want to test? FP16 and 4-bit quant (q4_0) for initial perf. Also need tokenization sanity check for embeddings shape.

Sarah Lee: embeddings shape: model returns 1536 dims? The README is vague. I'll run a quick embed probe once we have the model artifact.

Olivia Chen: small manifest snippet (draft):
```
model: helios-9b
source: github.com/helios/helios-9b
license: TBD
default_precision: fp16
owner: eng-ml/olivia
curation_owner: eng-ml/sarah
legal_owner: eng-ml/maria
perf_profile: pending
```

James O'Neill: pinging ingest-bot to start checksum + provenance checks once license is cleared.

ingest-bot: manifest received (pre-check) for helios-9b. awaiting license field. checksum: pending.

Kevin Patel: quick perf plan draft:
- small-batch latency (seq_len 128) on p4d --> target p95 < 200ms
- throughput test (batching 8, seq_len 512) --> target > 120 tokens/s
- quant eval: compare gen-quality delta < 3% on our BLEU/ROUGE proxies

Sarah Lee: can we add a regression prompt set for hallucination checks? small focused set for factual QA.

Olivia Chen: yes, add to checklist. Also need a canary rollout plan: 1% hosted, 5% dedicated warmup, monitoring on cost + perplexity drift.

Maria Gomez: FYI if license has attribution requirement we must include license metadata in API responses. I'll note that.

James O'Neill: action items summary:
- Maria to confirm license and call out NC/attribution (ETA: tonight)
- Sarah to produce eval + embed probe (ETA: Tue)
- Kevin to run perf baselines after artifact + workload (ETA: next week)
- Olivia to finalize manifest + canary doc once license is clarified (ETA: Wed)

Olivia Chen: if anyone wants ownership changed ping here. otherwise I'll start the rollout doc after Maria confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Sarah Lee: quick question — who will handle model card? I can draft but need input on safety notes.

Olivia Chen: Sarah to draft model card, Maria to add legal notes, Kevin to add perf numbers.

Kevin Patel: one more infra note — kernel selection may need a custom op for rotary embeddings; I'll flag on the infra ticket if we see perf anomalies.

Maria Gomez: spotted an edge: license file has a clause about downstream redistribution. That could block public hosted API. I'll post exact snippet in the doc.

Olivia Chen: good catch. ok team — let's keep async. I'll update the checklist when Maria posts the license snippet.

James O'Neill: thanks — adding blockers tag to the doc so PMs see it.

ingest-bot: checksum and provenance workflow queued. will post results as comments when complete.

Sarah Lee: noted. I'll wait for artifact then run embed probe and hallucination prompts.

Kevin Patel: marking perf ticket as blocked until license/artifact available.

Olivia Chen: end of thread — will post follow-ups here.
